name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add an always-visible, high-contrast focus ring to every interactive element. This guarantees keyboard users can see where they are at a glance, which is critical for people who rely on tabbing through pages. The trade-off is a slight visual clutter for sighted mouse users, but that’s minor compared to the accessibility win.

name: Reader
text: The always-visible ring overloads sighted keyboard users—cognitive noise rises with long lists, and the 250 ms delay risks dropping the ring entirely for users tabbing at 125 ms. Instead, show the ring only after a 100 ms pause on focus, then hide it after 2 seconds of inactivity. Test with Playwright MCP: measure time-to-target for keyboard users at 125 ms tab speed and track sighted users’ task completion time with/without the ring.
